summary.text: Marc Joseph Sosnowski, a U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 12th District to Rashida Tlaib.
A Detroit native with a background in property management and sales, he had run in several earlier local, university-board and congressional races.

paragraphs.text: Sosnowski was born in Detroit and graduated from Detroit Catholic Central High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan-Dearborn in 1978 and a graduate degree from Cornerstone University in 2009.

His career experience includes work as a business consultant and in sales, property management, insurance, environmental testing and bio-ethics, and Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with the U.S. Taxpayers Party, Right to Life, Lifespan and the Knights of Columbus.

Sosnowski ran unsuccessfully for the Wayne State University Board of Governors in 2018 and 2022, for Wayne County Commission District 8 in 2020 and 2024, and for U.S. House in the 2018 special election in Michigan's 13th District.
The U.S. Taxpayers Party nominated him at its convention on July 18, 2026.
He received 0.6% of the vote to Rashida Tlaib's 76.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
